**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on AP. Section 1 (p0001) affirmatively states the arrangement is non-exclusive and that AP remains free to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties; the Section 2 licence is likewise non-exclusive. The only limits on AP are standard licence-use terms in Section 6(a) (no reverse engineering, no third-party access, no service-bureau resale of the *Service*), which police use of Kubient's platform rather than restricting AP's businesses or products — outside the NONCOMPETE rule's boundary. Section 12(d) also preserves independent development. No redline required.
